svg.aria-label: Starlight Camera manual setup: phone only, no PC, no ADB, no root
svg.text: Starlight Camera vMax .51 · Redmi Note 10 Pro Max
Everything happens on the phone. No PC, no cable, no root.
Get these three files on the phone

g.text: Open Releases in your phone browser.
Tap each file — they land in Download.
Uninstall it. The package name is the
same, so it cannot sit beside the new one.
Allow installs from your file manager
if Android asks. No root, no ADB.
Launch Starlight Camera from the drawer.
You should land on the viewfinder.
Double-tap the black area by the shutter.
The app restarts itself, already tuned.
In Main, Tele, Wide and Front pick
Video upscale for 4K, Potato mode if slow.

svg.text: uninstall the old LMC / GCam first
turn Auto upscale on in Settings
